stepExplanation: Since A + T = 44% (22% + 22%), the remaining 56% must be divided equally between G and C (because G=C). Therefore, G = C = 56%/2 = 28% each.
stepBody: Now that you know A = 22% and T = 22%, calculate the percentage of guanine (G) and cytosine (C). Remember: all four bases must add up to 100%, and G = C.
